strategies.name: Round trip
strategies.description: Original demonstration: submit an entry, then an exit on the next eligible observation.

strategies.name: Buy and hold
strategies.description: Original example: submit one market entry at start; the position remains open until the run ends.

strategies.name: Market event observer
strategies.description: Original read-only template: count matching market events without submitting orders.

strategies.name: Moving average crossover
strategies.description: Fast/slow SMA crossover with separate timeframe-minute parameters. Register once in OnStart; completed candles update automatically; prior selected replay data or compatible live history warms the averages. Supports bars, bid quotes or trades. Any minute interval from 1 to 1440 is supported. Averages are compared as entered; equal settings stay flat.

strategies.name: Mean reversion
strategies.description: Prior-window z-score using automatically updated timeframe bands. TimeframeMinutes selects completed candles; Previous excludes the current candle. Earlier selected data or compatible live history warms prices. Zero variance does not trade; ExitZ must be smaller than EntryZ.

strategies.name: Channel breakout
strategies.description: Breakout against prior candle highs/lows. TimeframeMinutes selects the candle frequency; a bounded bar window requests compatible live history. The newest candle is excluded from both channels. Supports bars, bid quotes or trades.

strategies.name: Trade momentum
strategies.description: Momentum over Lookback completed trade-price candles, with configurable TimeframeMinutes and compatible live history warm-up. Trade execution uses actual trades; pending remainders prevent duplicate exposure.

strategies.name: Quote momentum
strategies.description: Momentum over completed bid-price candles, with configurable TimeframeMinutes and compatible bid-history warm-up. Quote execution uses actual bid/ask. At each candle close, zero sizes or excessive current spread flatten the target; candle history is retained.

strategies.name: Multi-symbol trend
strategies.description: Independent timeframe SMAs for Symbol and OtherSymbol. TimeframeMinutes selects completed candles and each symbol requests its own compatible history. Supports explicitly selected bars, quotes or trades. No cross-symbol history or invented observations.

strategies.name: Multi time zones UTC session trend
strategies.description: Trade-price timeframe SMA gated by Tokyo 09:00-15:30 or New York 09:30-16:00 local weekdays (DST respected). TimeframeMinutes is configurable; compatible history warms prices across sessions. Checks the session and exits at the next completed candle decision. Not a holiday calendar.

strategies.name: Quote + trades confirmation
strategies.description: Completed trade-candle momentum with configurable TimeframeMinutes and compatible history warm-up. Entry also requires an actual trade at/above a fresh observed ask; stale/invalid quotes flatten the target at the next completed candle decision. Select both quote and trade streams; no historical quote confirmation is invented.

strategies.name: Passive bid / ask ladder
strategies.description: Two-sided limit ladder based on observed quotes. Requires Quote execution; TickSize 0 reads Symbol.TickSize. Optional local trading windows use Symbol.TimeZone; cancel owned quotes during breaks and resume on fresh in-window quotes after confirmation. Existing positions remain open. Filled inventory occupies inner levels. Up to 5 levels per side, bounded signed inventory, conservative cancel/acknowledge/reseed refreshes. Can hold short positions; configure cash, margin and commissions. L1 quotes do not establish exchange queue position: replay uses the selected fill/liquidity model, never invented depth.

strategies.name: News-filter moving average
strategies.description: Timeframe SMA crossover gated by arrived NewsAPI.ai sentiment. TimeframeMinutes configures both averages; compatible live history warms prices only. Same-symbol eligible news must still arrive. Snapshot timing by default; no future news.

strategies.name: J-Quants statements + price forecast
strategies.description: Original one-next-bar rule: observed price trend + same-disclosure operating margin. Needs exact FS labels, statement information + prices; not trained ML.

strategies.name: J-Quants fundamentals + price forecast
strategies.description: Original one-next-bar rule: observed price trend + same-disclosure EPS/BPS feature. Needs summary information + prices; no annualization or trained ML.

strategies.name: Typed callback observer
strategies.description: Beginner template: observe bar-open, completed-bar, trade and quote callbacks for one symbol. Counts events without placing orders; validate after opening.

strategies.name: Blank new strategy
strategies.description: The editable New strategy scaffold; observes events without placing orders.
